question: Should OpenClaw bundle native xAI realtime voice now with this ten-setting provider config surface and runtime WebSocket dependency?
rationale: The implementation fits existing architecture, but accepting a new bundled provider, durable operator-facing configuration contract, and shipped dependency is a product and ownership decision that automated review cannot make.

options.title: Bundle the provider
options.body: Accept the gateway-relay provider after rebase, exact-head real behavior proof, and trusted dependency authorization.

options.title: Narrow the public config
options.body: Keep the provider but reduce or defer optional settings such as session resumption before establishing the supported contract.

options.title: Do not bundle it
options.body: Decline the core feature and leave xAI realtime voice to an external plugin if bundled provider scope should remain smaller.

recommendation.title: Bundle the provider
recommendation.body: Accept the gateway-relay provider after rebase, exact-head real behavior proof, and trusted dependency authorization.

likelyOwner.reason: His merged history introduced and refined the plugin-owned realtime voice architecture that this product decision extends.
